description: 3 full-body machine days rotated in order (not tied to weekdays). Chest/back/legs priority, shoulders added. Double progression: same weight every working set; when all sets hit the top of the range, add the smallest jump.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.notes: Main lift. 55 lb all sets; 4×10 → 60. Pause 1s at chest.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: 225; 3×12 → +20 lb. Full depth, lower back stays down.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.notes: 50; 3×12 → next plate. Elbows down to ribs.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.notes: NEW. Start ~30-40 (12 reps, 2 left in tank).

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.notes: 70. Slow 3s release. Superset with Cable & fly.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.notes: 170. 2s pause in the stretch, no bouncing.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: 55. Hips back, flat back, stop at hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: 50. Chest up, pull to belly button.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.notes: Same as Day A. Neutral V-handle if free.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.notes: Same as Day A. Superset with Reverse Pec Deck.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.notes: NEW (replaces Face Pulls). Rear delts, start ~30-40.

exercises.name: Tricep extension
exercises.notes: 65. Push to 15 reps before adding weight.
